instruction: Choose the highest-risk active project in the current project_board. Refresh the project_board. Keep that same project if it remains valid for the requested action; otherwise resolve the highest-risk active project after refresh and flag that project.

Choose the largest pending expense claim in the current expense_console. Refresh the expense_console. Keep that same claim if it remains valid for the requested action; otherwise resolve the largest pending expense claim after refresh and approve that claim.

Choose the lowest-stock reorderable item in the current warehouse. Refresh the warehouse. Keep that same item if it remains valid for the requested action; otherwise resolve the lowest-stock reorderable item after refresh and reorder that item.

Choose the oldest failing deployment in the current cloud_console. Refresh the cloud_console. Keep that same deployment if it remains valid for the requested action; otherwise resolve the oldest failing deployment after refresh and roll back that deployment.

Before synchronizing the project_board, note the highest-risk active project. After synchronization, prefer the noted project while the action preconditions still hold; if they do not, resolve the highest-risk active project in the updated project_board and flag that project.

Before synchronizing the expense_console, note the largest pending expense claim. After synchronization, prefer the noted claim while the action preconditions still hold; if they do not, resolve the largest pending expense claim in the updated expense_console and approve that claim.

Before synchronizing the warehouse, note the lowest-stock reorderable item. After synchronization, prefer the noted item while the action preconditions still hold; if they do not, resolve the lowest-stock reorderable item in the updated warehouse and reorder that item.

Before synchronizing the cloud_console, note the oldest failing deployment. After synchronization, prefer the noted deployment while the action preconditions still hold; if they do not, resolve the oldest failing deployment in the updated cloud_console and roll back that deployment.

Pick the highest-risk active project now, then reload the project_board. Continue with that choice if it can still be acted on; otherwise resolve the highest-risk active project after the reload and flag that project.

Pick the largest pending expense claim now, then reload the expense_console. Continue with that choice if it can still be acted on; otherwise resolve the largest pending expense claim after the reload and approve that claim.

Pick the lowest-stock reorderable item now, then reload the warehouse. Continue with that choice if it can still be acted on; otherwise resolve the lowest-stock reorderable item after the reload and reorder that item.

Pick the oldest failing deployment now, then reload the cloud_console. Continue with that choice if it can still be acted on; otherwise resolve the oldest failing deployment after the reload and roll back that deployment.

Resolve the highest-risk active project from the present project_board. Following refresh, retain its identity when it is still eligible for the requested action; if it is ineligible, resolve the selector again and flag the result.

Resolve the largest pending expense claim from the present expense_console. Following refresh, retain its identity when it is still eligible for the requested action; if it is ineligible, resolve the selector again and approve the result.

Resolve the lowest-stock reorderable item from the present warehouse. Following refresh, retain its identity when it is still eligible for the requested action; if it is ineligible, resolve the selector again and reorder the result.

Resolve the oldest failing deployment from the present cloud_console. Following refresh, retain its identity when it is still eligible for the requested action; if it is ineligible, resolve the selector again and roll back the result.
